lemmas.name: pow2_iff
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n : Int), (∃ x : Nat, _root_.pow 2 x = n ∧ n > 0) ↔ (List.range (n.toNat + 1)).any (fun x => decide (_root_.pow 2 x = n ∧ n > 0)) = true
lemmas.proof:
by intro n
  have hp : ∀ x : Nat, _root_.pow 2 x = (2 : Int) ^ x := by
    intro x
    induction x with
    | zero => simp [_root_.pow]
    | succ k ih => simp [_root_.pow, ih, pow_succ]; ring
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hn⟩
    rw [List.any_eq_true]
    refine ⟨x, List.mem_range.mpr ?_, by simpa using ⟨hx, hn⟩⟩
    have h1 : x < 2 ^ x := Nat.lt_pow_self (by omega)
    rw [hp] at hx
    have h2 : ((2 ^ x : Nat) : Int) = n := by rw [← hx]; push_cast; ring
    omega
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨x, _, hx⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp h
    exact ⟨x, by simpa using hx⟩

lemmas.name: pow2_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n : Int) (h : isPowerOfTwo_precond n), isPowerOfTwo_postcond n ((List.range (n.toNat + 1)).any (fun x => decide (_root_.pow 2 x = n ∧ n > 0))) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro n h
  unfold isPowerOfTwo_postcond
  split_ifs with hb
  · exact (pow2_iff n).mpr hb
  · intro hex; exact hb ((pow2_iff n).mp hex)
